verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no account-wide data export, takeout, or portability feature for leaving Luma. The 16-bit EXR export in luma-docs-13 and luma-docs-16 is a per-render output format for compositing and color grading. That is a related but different feature: it is not an export of all user data such as projects, prompts, history, or assets, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
